  body={{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"Destination name, unique within the project","maxLength":40,"minLength":1,"pattern":"^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$"},"bucketName":{"type":"string","description":"Name of a bucket in this project, managed by the bucket service. Enforcement is driver-side."}},"description":"CreateDestinationRequest deliberately carries no endpoint, access-key or\nsecret-key field. Storage coordinates are derived from the referenced\nbucket, and the way to guarantee a caller cannot supply them is for the\nfields not to exist.\n\nThat invariant survives external storage rather than being traded away for\nit: a destination will name a credential created through its own operation,\nso the coordinates still never ride on this message.\n\nThe storage source is exactly one of the bucket pair or, later, a\ncredential. The fields are flat and the exclusivity is the validator's\n(validateStorageSource), as the contract conventions require of exclusive\ninputs: a oneof renders as unrelated optional properties in OpenAPI."}}},"required":true}}
